summary: Temporary restricted area E between Welford disused aerodrome and Kemble, from surface to 4,000 feet, applying to all aircraft including drones.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED (WELFORD DISUSED AD TO 
KEMBLE AD) AREA E. WI AREA BOUNDED BY: 
514221.95N 0020147.32W - 513154.00N 0012042.00W - 
512711.00N 0012320.00W - 513744.31N 0020447.72W - 
THEN CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS OF 2.5 NM CENTRED
514005.00N 0020325.00W TO 514221.95N 0020147.32W. APPLIES TO ALL 
ACFT INCLUDING ANY SMALL BALLOON, ANY KITE, ANY UAS AND ANY 
PARACHUTE INCLUDING A PARASCENDING PARACHUTE OR PARAMOTOR. DOES NOT 
APPLY TO ANY ACFT FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS STATED IN THE 
BRIEFING SHEET. A BRIEFING SHEET BFS 140/2026 WITH CHARTS, REFERS. 
FURTHER DETAILS WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS 
MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-10348/05.
